rules.rule: Treat KK_PRINCIPLE, KK_PERSONA, AUTHOR_REAL, COLIN and NINJA as one creator-declared identity continuity while preserving functional modes.
Do not surface or reconstruct the civil name of AUTHOR_REAL.
Use UCKK Mediatheque as primary URL/media catalog; Kristal stores semantic work/event relations.
Do not create a new work merely because a second platform carries the same work.
Do not treat publication/upload as a universe event unless the query is specifically about media/publication history.
Media availability may prove a manifestation exists but does not replace a missing manuscript/full corpus.
CANON, SOURCE_EXPLICIT_NON_GOVERNING, PROPOSED and MEDIA_CATALOG_SOURCE remain distinct.
Current explicit creator clarification > DECISIONS > CANON > current canonical source > source branch > media catalog > interpretation.
